original_test_intent: Enumerate every expected HGX GPU and NVLink edge with NVQual Test #9 and prove the observed full fabric graph, per-link state/generation/count and topology matrix exactly match the project model without hang, reboot or new fabric errors.
original_method: Pin the HGX GPU serial/UUID-to-slot model, expected undirected/directed NVLink adjacency and link attributes, driver/firmware/fabric-manager state and Test #9 revision; preserve baseline logs; collect full untruncated NVQual, nvlink status and topology outputs via trusted access; normalize identities and compare all expected and unexpected nodes/edges; do not reset links to force agreement.
manual_activity: Owner/FAE supplies the authoritative expected fabric graph, versions and acceptance; the agent may collect/compare evidence, while the owner adjudicates any topology mismatch.
required_inputs: Licensed pinned NVQual Test #9 and compatible driver/firmware/fabric-manager
Expected full NVLink adjacency, per-link generation/count/state and topology matrix
Secure access, normalization rules, acceptable disabled/unpopulated handling and error criteria
safety_requirements: Use authenticated trusted access and protect credentials
Export logs rather than clear them; collect complete outputs without head/grep truncation
Do not reset NVLinks, restart fabric manager or mutate topology to force a pass
Stop on missing/degraded links, fabric-manager failure, GPU loss, host instability, thermal/power fault or incomplete identity/evidence
agent_execution_scope: Validate tool/version, GPU identities, expected graph and fabric-manager health
Collect full raw NVQual #9, nvlink status, topology matrix and correlated logs
Compare node and edge sets with link attributes and report discrepancies
Do not guess the expected graph, mutate fabric state or issue the DUT verdict
engineer_actions: Approve authoritative GPU/link graph and version prerequisites
Resolve any graph mismatch and decide PASS, FAIL, or BLOCKED

modernized_recommendation.status: IDENTITY-BOUND FULL NVLINK FABRIC GRAPH VALIDATION
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Represent expected and observed fabrics as GPU-identity-bound graphs with per-edge port/link generation/state attributes and generate a lossless node/edge diff alongside raw evidence.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds authoritative graph, stable identity normalization, complete secure artifacts, fabric-manager health and explicit no-mutation boundary.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A plausible topology matrix or device count can hide swapped identities, missing parallel links, wrong generations, degraded states or unexpected edges.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Tool labels can change across driver revisions, so serial/UUID/slot normalization is required; observation should not alter fabric state.

project_override_considerations: A project-specific topology parser may be used only when its expected graph and normalization are versioned and raw NVQual/nvidia-smi artifacts are retained. Missing tools are readiness pending, not DUT failure.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash, approved Test #9 manifest/license/version and authorization
HGX GPU UUID/serial/slot inventory plus expected full node/edge/link-attribute graph
Complete raw NVQual #9, nvidia-smi nvlink status/topology matrix and timestamps

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, Test #9 Procedure, Criteria and same-row AI review consistently target NVLink enumeration/topology. The missing expected graph is readiness under-specification, not a competing objective.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The fabric enumeration objective is clear. Licensed tooling, expected topology and identity map are identifiable prerequisites rather than permanent review blockers.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Functionality row 2135 Wistron-HGX NV PVP HW-00012-V002: approve the pinned NVQual Test #9/driver/firmware/fabric-manager versions, GPU UUID/serial/slot map, complete expected NVLink adjacency and per-link port/generation/count/state matrix, disabled/unpopulated handling, graph normalization and error acceptance.

review_improvement: Turns generic enumeration into a stable-identity full fabric graph comparison and removes insecure/truncated collection and reset-to-pass behavior.
independent_technical_reasoning: Fabric completeness is a graph property, not a GPU count. Every GPU node and NVLink edge must be bound to stable identities and expected attributes; otherwise symmetric devices can be swapped and missing parallel links can remain unnoticed. Raw untruncated evidence and a versioned expected graph make discrepancies auditable without changing the fabric.
